title: Add adaptive task starters to the unified workspace
expectedTask:
Add three accessible starter buttons to the sole Vercel workspace: Analyze a dataset, Improve a repository, and Approved browser task. Selecting one must only fill the editable composer; it must not submit, call a network/model, change routing, or select Cloud Pro. Keep Zero-Codex as the default. Change only allowed paths, run focused verification, and return the assignment branch for Primary review.

Acceptance criteria:
All three starters are visible and keyboard accessible. Activation only fills the composer. Zero-Codex stays selected and Cloud Pro remains opt-in. Focused tests prove no auto-submit and all verification commands pass.

Skill profile: UI and frontend.
Source workspace issue: https://github.com/michaeljwilliams0123/mahoraga/issues/87. Repository-safe attachment references remain in that issue and are not copied into the coordination record.
